description: Data i Miljødirektoratet is the Norwegian Environment Agency's entry point to its data. The pages read on 2026-09-28 state that the agency's official data and products are freely available and list its map catalogue, its datasets in the Geonorge and national data catalogues, and applications that open one or more datasets: Grunnforurensning (known and suspected contaminated ground in Norway and Svalbard), Norske utslipp (emissions to air and water and waste from industry and other sectors, including annual reports from regulated facilities), greenhouse gas emissions by municipality and sector, Vannmiljø and Vann-nett (water environment data and water body status), Naturbase (mapped nature and outdoor recreation areas), local air quality forecasts, the marine environment, and wildlife registers, plus publications and public records. Coverage is national. Access is free through catalogues, applications and APIs; the licence name is not stated on the pages read, although Norwegian public data commonly use NLOD. Caveats: this is a portal, and each dataset has its own scope and update cycle. It supports environmental constraint and exposure layers for infrastructure studies, such as contaminated sites along planned routes and permitted industrial emitters. No related Norwegian environment record is catalogued; Geonorge datasets complement it.
